# Large-map disposable fixtures

- `FileOrbit-20-categories.orbit`: supplied realistic sample, 246 authoritative nodes.
- `FileOrbit-300.orbit`: 300 nodes.
- `FileOrbit-301.orbit`: 301 nodes.
- `FileOrbit-1000.orbit`: 1,000 nodes.

300/301/1,000: 20 categories, root `README-root.md`, valid TXT/MD/PDF/PNG and attachments. `generate.mjs` is the reproducible generator.

Free admission is 300. Open 301/1,000 only with the explicit `?paidTest=1` internal test context.

Capacity ladder (`400`–`900`) is generated by `generate.mjs`. Structural cases `wide-400`, `dense-400`, `deep-400` are generated by `generate-structures.mjs`.
